gloss: to support, to nourish, to cultivate

definitions.explanation: To financially or materially support someone, especially family members.
To provide sustenance or care for growth and development.
To develop a skill, ability, or quality over time.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}を{養|やしな}うために{働|はたら}く。
examples.english: I work to support my family.

examples.japanese: {一人|ひとり}で{三人|さんにん}の{子|こ}どもを{養|やしな}っている。
examples.english: She supports three children on her own.

examples.japanese: {給料|きゅうりょう}だけでは{家族|かぞく}を{養|やしな}うのが{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's hard to support a family on salary alone.

examples.japanese: {栄養|えいよう}のある{食事|しょくじ}で{体|からだ}を{養|やしな}う。
examples.english: I nourish my body with nutritious meals.

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}の{後|あと}は{十分|じゅうぶん}に{休|やす}んで{体|からだ}を{養|やしな}うことが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: After an illness, it's important to rest well and nourish your body.

examples.japanese: {温泉|おんせん}で{英気|えいき}を{養|やしな}う。
examples.english: I refresh my energy at the hot springs.

examples.japanese: {体力|たいりょく}を{養|やしな}う。
examples.english: I build up my physical strength.

examples.japanese: {読書|どくしょ}で{教養|きょうよう}を{養|やしな}う。
examples.english: I cultivate my education through reading.

examples.japanese: {美術|びじゅつ}{館|かん}に{通|かよ}って、{美|うつく}しいものを{見|み}る{目|め}を{養|やしな}った。
examples.english: I developed an eye for beauty by frequenting art museums.

notes:
{養|やしな}う has meanings related to support, nourishment, and cultivation.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {家族|かぞく}を{養|やしな}う: to support one's family
- {力|ちから}を{養|やしな}う: to build up one's strength
- {教養|きょうよう}を{養|やしな}う: to cultivate one's education
- {目|め}を{養|やしな}う: to develop an eye for (something)

RELATED WORDS:
- {育|そだ}てる: to raise, bring up
- {扶養|ふよう}する: to support (formal)
- {栄養|えいよう}: nutrition

[Register: Neutral]
